start: ^Agent HaX: Before anything else, read the note I've just sent you. If your phone is ever compromised, that's how you reach me.
cover: ^Agent HaX: Freshers' week at Miskatonic University. You're a first-year again.
^Agent HaX: CryptoSecure Recovery has a stand in the Computing foyer. They're funding something called the Keyholder Studentship. Nine thousand a year, fees paid.
^Agent HaX: Nobody applies. You're found, by solving a trail of puzzles around the building. They call it the Trials.
^Agent HaX: Two of last year's Keyholders now work for CryptoSecure. CryptoSecure is Ransomware Incorporated with a logo.

c-0: ^Agent HaX: Yes. Ghost's. St Catherine's was theirs.
c-1: ^Agent HaX: Get picked. I want someone inside their recruitment.

ghost: ^Agent HaX: Ransomware Incorporated is run by someone who calls themselves Ghost. St Catherine's was theirs.
ghost_known: ^Agent HaX: No name, no face. A voice on a console, and a hood on a screen.
why_me: ^Agent HaX: Ghost never saw your face. You saw theirs, near enough: a hood on a screen.
^Agent HaX: And if they do know you and still want you, that tells us more than a clean recruit ever could.
cliffe: ^Agent HaX: One more name. Dr Cliffe Schreuders. Builds Hacktivity. He'll know what you are within a minute of meeting you.
deploy: ^Agent HaX: Every Trial opens with something you decode. You'll do it in CyberChef.
^Agent HaX: Get a lab laptop from Dr Shaw in the teaching lab, west of the foyer. Then go and be found.
briefing_done: ^Agent HaX: Dr Shaw first. Then the stand.
